name: Nathalie Koenders
bio: Nathalie Koenders, born 1 March 1977 in Rennes, is a French Socialist Party politician and Mayor of Dijon. A former high-level canoe-kayak athlete and public servant in the youth and sports sector, she served as first deputy mayor (premiere adjointe) of Dijon from 2014, briefly as acting mayor in 2015, and as departmental councillor for Cote-d'Or (canton Dijon-2) from 2015. She became the first woman mayor of Dijon on 25 November 2024 when François Rebsamen resigned the office to join the national government, then won her first election as PS list leader in the March 2026 municipal elections.
